title.text: DRAFT — Two of the three markets rank first or second in their state; Sydney’s ranks 13th
subtitle: DRAFT — International visitors who went to each attraction in 2025. Counts are people, not visits: someone who
went three times during their trip is counted once. Each state is ranked against its own attractions only, and the
three scales differ, so the panels say where a market sits at home, not how the three markets compare.
